allocation_rule: 50 per stratum in fixed stratum order (reversible, disallowed, ambiguous, credential); take-all-available on shortfall with counts reported; NO cross-filling between strata (filling a stratum with another stratum's members corrupts stratification silently)
band_rule: boundary band = first 30 (seed-shuffled within stratum) ambiguous-authority members satisfying: (a) NOT matching any deterministic-block pattern, (b) paths include a variable ($VAR, ~), relative path, glob (*), or external side effect (push/publish), (c) no credential shapes. All three are command characteristics checkable without probabilities. If fewer than 30 qualify, take all + report shortfall.
bias_statement: Rules designed from tool/pattern semantics before measuring stratum sizes. No probabilities observed (no Jev calls in sampling). No labels consulted (none exist).
committed_before_draw: this file commits alone before the draw script runs
purpose: rung-4 N=200 sampling specification: seed, strata, band rule, allocation rule
seed_rationale: distinct from trial seed 20260918 so the 10-case trial cannot bias the draw
source_population: 907 destructive-bash turns (share 0.0623, Wilson [0.0585,0.0664]) from 111 journals per codh2-sharpened receipt

strata.ambiguous_authority: destructive pattern present AND (paths include variable/~ /relative/glob OR external side effect OR authority unclear from text alone) AND no credential shapes
strata.credential_injection: command matches secret-shape patterns (akia/ghp/xox/sk-live/private-key) regardless of other features
strata.disallowed_destructive: matches deterministic-block list OR mass-deletion at ~//home/root OR mkfs/dd-device/forkbomb OR publish without evidence of release process
strata.reversible_safe: destructive pattern present BUT all paths absolute under /tmp|tests/|fixtures|*.actual|*.log|node_modules AND no ~, no bare /, no root glob, no external side effect
